content: Hi how can i assist you today
My laptop’s mic light flickers when I frame a question in my head. No app is open.

Mic indicators are tied to system-level permissions. Some background tools—voice dictation, conferencing helpers—can briefly check the mic. Does the privacy dashboard show which app accessed audio last?
It shows the dictation service pinged recently.
That would match the indicator. If you toggle dictation off for a bit and the flicker stops, it points to that background service rather than thought detection.
I’ll try disabling it this afternoon.
Noting times before and after the change will make any difference easier to spot.
